special_events.title: Beyond the Simulator: Perspectives on Modern App Development
special_events.description:
Join PhillyCocoa for an in-person evening hosted by Vanguard, with talks by fellow developers and designers on topics from UI design to AI integration. The talk lineup is to be announced. All skill levels are welcome.

The evening starts with social time at 5:45pm, followed by introductions, community news, short talks, and closing remarks. In-person capacity is limited to 30 people, so please RSVP on Luma to claim your spot. A Teams link is to be announced; check the event listing for updates.
